tutorial_text.text:
Posture is a measure of the opponent's ability to keep up their defense.

Most combat interactions with the opponent, defensive or offensive, increases their posture meter.



RECOVERY

The opponent's posture meter will start to reduce if they are idle and have not weathered a posture-damaging action for a short time.

While the opponent attacks, their posture recovery will pause.

Opponents defending or being hit by attacks also cause a brief period of posture recovery pause.



FULL POSTURE

When the posture meter is full, the opponent will no longer block attacks.

Performing an attack during a bash's stun effect will deal significantly greater damage and recover the enemy's posture.



REDUCED POSTURE RECOVERY

The rate that posture recovers is cut if the opponent has sustained some health damage.

This regen penalty applies every quarter of their health drained.
